_comment: Row 703. One mutant per httpx client construction in the tracked application package, generated from the same tree-derived census the gate uses: each renames the construction's transport= keyword (zero-width insertion between 'transport' and '='), so the construction no longer carries a transport and the drift gate must name it. The reconciliation test asserts this spec's per-file count equals the tree's.
subject: every httpx client construction is pinned through the guarded transport seam
